"Verifiable Credentials" unfortunately are associated with the W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model, mostly because they were "first".

In other parts of the ecosystem, we've been really trying to align on "verifiable digital credentials" (short: "VDCs") as the more general, credential format agnostic name for the technology (covers W3C VC DM, SD-JWT VC, mdoc, etc).

Suggest using this name in the spec/docs instead of "Verifiable Credentials", unless you're specifically saying W3C VC DM.
t: Use verifiable digital credential instead of Verifiable Credential
